balls.text: glanced to short fine leg, it's the last ball so the batsmen charge through for the second, they just about make their ground
that's the end of Smith, he tried to slog it over long-on, it was a flat, powerful hit but is taken by Raut at the boundary
swiped towards midwicket for a single this time
Teja is off the mark with a four, sweet shot that, on the pads, Teja gets on his knee and sweeps, ensures the placement is perfect
faster from Yusuf, 98.5kmh, yorker just outside off, clubbed towards long-on for a single
slightly short from Yusuf, swung away towards midwicket, a fumble allows Smith to come back for the second
Smith plays it with soft hands towards mid-off, takes the single to retain the strike
width for Smith, cuts it powerfully but straight to the fielder at point
good flight from Warne, Venugopal came down the pitch and lofts it down the ground, only as far as Ravindra Jadeja at long-on
played to deep cover for a single
short ball, sat up nicely for Smith, he won't miss those, swings it over wide long-on for a huge six
driven inside-out though the covers for a single
wristily worked towards square leg for a single this time
another brilliant stroke, this time from Venu, it was a wide yorker, Venu just bends his knees and slides it off the face of the bat past short third man for a boundary
back of a length on offstump, Smith jumps and defends it towards point
Shot of the match so far from Smith, hardly any backlift as he swung a full ball on middle and leg over the midwicket boundary, that was an amazing stroke
slower offcutter from Trivedi, 11kmh, pretty short, Venu opens the face to guide it to third man
Trivedi starts with a shortish ball, Venu pulls off the backfoot, Raut should have been an easy stop for Raut at deep square leg, who lets it through his hands
Smith attempts a repeat, doesn't hit it as well as the previous ball, it lands a few yards short of Graeme Smith at deep midwicket
Smith's starting to get a move on here, a little short from Yusuf, Smith stays on the backfoot and waits for it, swats it in front of square leg for a six, scattering some fans in the stands
on the  pads, tickled down to short fine leg for a single
Smith is on strike though, he mows it towards midwicket, only a single though

Vaas is gone this time, holes out to wide long-on, he was always looking to shuffle down the track right through his innings, he does it again, Yusuf sends down a short ball, Vaas can only swipe it to the waiting Lee Carseldine

length ball, Vaas was down the track and hammering that, didn't get the height and was nearly out caught-and-bowled, very difficult chance, get a couple as the ball richochets off Pathan's hands towards long-on
Bang! Jadeja's final ball disappears over long-on for a huge six, minimum of fuss, just gets the front leg out of the way and swings it, clean hit
keeps it very full, on legstump again, Smith digs it out, but the ball doesn't go anywhere, Smith takes a couple of strides for a single realises the ball is still near the stumps and beats a retreat
low full toss on the pads, Vaas drives it to mid-on for a single
full and flat on middle stump, squeezed out towards mid-on, Jadeja charges after it to do the fielding
deftly dabbed past short third man by Smith, Munaf Patel has a lot of running to do before he catches up with the ball
length ball outside off, defended towards cover
streaky for Vaas, he was waltzing down the pitch, Raut pushed it wide outside off, Vaas gets a thick bottom-edge which beats the keeper and the batsmen get themselves a couple
Smith turns it to deep midwicket for a single
a bit short from Raut, Vaas slaps it hard down to long-off this time
swipes it again, doesn't get it like the last time but it lands safely short of long-on
Vaas charges down the pitch, doesn't quite get to the pitch, and hoicks it over long-on for a much-needed six
tosses up his first ball, on the pads, dabbed towards midwicket
slightly ovepitched, on legstump, Smith swings it away to dep backward square leg for a single
Vaas comes down the track and goes for a big heave, gets a bit of an under edge as the ball races towards midwicket
length ball outside off, muscled away towards wide long-on by Smith, off the backfoot
tries to slap it over the infield, doesn't quite get hold of it, and the bowler has to run back to do the fielding
full ball which a bit slower, 126kmph, whipped away towards midwicket
starts with a back of length ball angling across Vaas, who cracks it down the ground towards long-off
a bit of flight from Yusuf, swing and a miss from Smith
driven firmly down to long-off for a single
a touch shorter, around legstump, some turn for Yusuf, Vaas misses as he tries to flick and is hit on the pads
overpitched, full and flat, played back to the bowler
again on the pads, and square leg fielder is into the action again
starts a length ball on the pads, which is nudged towards square leg
full on middle, played back to the bowler
fired in flat towards the legstump, Smith tries to carve him inside-out, doesn't get hold of it and the ball swirls just out of reach of the fielder at extra cover
whipped his first ball this season from outside off to midwicket to get off the mark

Jadeja's on song today, another big wicket for him, Symonds is bowled, that was very full pitching on legstump, Symonds hadn't been too comfortable against Jadeja all through, he plays around the ball as he tries to flick it, and the legstump is rocked back
short and a bit wide, played to backward point, no run
Jadeja strays onto the pads, goes off his pads to short fine leg
overpitched on legstump, wristy drive from Dwayne Smith fetches him a single to long-on
driven down to long-off for a single
superb footwork from Symonds, gets on the backfoot and opens himself up to whip the ball to the leg side
full on the pads, swept powerfully down to long leg
a bit fuller from Warne, Smith gets a big stride in and smother the turn with his defence
great delivery to start from Warne, nicely flighted, sharp turn takes the ball past Smith's outside edge
length ball outside off, Symonds golf-swings it for a one-bounce four wide of long-on
fired into the pads, Symonds shuffles across and flicks it to midwicket, there's a lot of confused calling but the batsmen get back for two comfortably in the end
full and wide from Jadeja, Dwayne Smith reaches out and drives it back past the bowler

Jadeja provides the breakthrough, soft dismissal, slightly faster in the air, the arm ball accounts for Rohit, who had come down the track and was looking for the turn, there wasn't any and the the batsman is beaten, simple stumping for Naman Ojha, who juggles with the ball a bit before breaking the stumps
turned away to square leg for a single
overpitched, Symonds cracks it down the pitch, Jadeja does well to bend to his left and stop it
on the pads, tickled down to short fine leg for a single to retain the strike
this was pretty short from Warne, Symonds opened himself up for a big heave, but that turned sharply away and stayed low as well, the batsman pulls out of the stroke
poked past the man at cover for another single
this time he waits on the backfoot and crunches it towards extra cover
Bang! Symonds is winning the battle so far, gets a big stride in and mows it over wide long-on for a six, against the spin as well
tossed up by Warne, Rohit plays it to long-off of the backfoot
length ball, pitching on middle, Rohit waits on it and slaps it down to long-on for a another single, good start from Jadeja, only five off that over
on middle and leg, easily worked away behind square leg
shout for lbw, as Symonds looks to play to midwicket, there was a thick inside edge though
Rohit sashays down the pitch and lofts it over the infield towards long-on
turns sharply into Symonds, who is taken by surprise, gets a bottom edge past the keeper
Jadeja starts with an overpitched ball outside off, driven down to long-off
full and on the pads, Rohit leans across and turns it in front of square leg
another shot off the backfoot, this time to the bowler's right for a single
short ball from Warne, sat up to be hit, Symonds doesn't miss out on these, whips it wide of midwicket for a boundary
lovely shot from Symonds, the turn gives him room to free his arms, he stays on the backfoot and carves it through the covers
slapped over the bowler's head, doesn't quite get hold of it, but the batsmen have the time to take a single
length ball, pitching on off, Symonds wasn't totally in control as he glides it towards third man, bit of turn on offer for Warne
back of a length, on offstump, played back towards the bowler off the backfoot

Trivedi persists with the short length, and it pays dividends, Suman holes out to midwicket, it was a good-looking shot but Suman managed to pick out the fielder in the deep, Lee Carseldine, who takes a well-judged catch looking into the sun
another short ball, on middle and leg, nicely dispatched to the deep backward square leg boundary by Suman, didn't try to hit it too hard, rolled his wrists to keep it down
fuller this time outside off, Suman tries to carve it over mid-off, just about manages to clear the infield
shortish ball, slower one as well, sat up to be hit, Suman waits on it and shovels it to the midwicket boundary, Abhishek Raut puts in a valiant dive but can stop the ball
starts with a tight delivery, just outside off, which is punched towards mid-off
a bit shorter, on middle and off, Rohit tried to flick it towards midwicket, is early on teh shot and the ball flies towards point off the back of the bat
Morkel cramps Suman for room with a length ball on offstump, defended back to the bowler by Suman
slightly short from Morkel, Suman tries to play it towards cover, gets an under-edge which goes towards the wicketkeeper on the bounce
whipped off his pads to midwicket for a couple of runs, Suman's moved on to 18
pushes up the length a bit, Rohit opens the face of the bat and glides it towards third man for a single
Morkel into his third over, first ball is back of a length outside off, defended by Rohit
full flat delivery, slammed over wide long-off by Suman for a six
full on the pads, and it's turned towards square leg for a single to get off the mark
Rohit Sharma defends his first ball back to the bowler

and the decision to bring in spin early works, Gilchrist is gone lbw, he was looking to sweep, misses and is hit on the pads, Rajasthan appeal and the umpire sends him on his way, he was unlucky though, replays show the ball pitched just outside legstump
a touch shorter, on middle and leg, flicked towards midwicket for a couple
starts with a full ball on legstump, worked to square leg by Gilchrist
Gilchrist ends the over with another single, nudged off his thigh pad towards square leg
fullish delivery outside off, Suman gets an outside edge down to third man, was in the air lands well short of the fielder
overpitched on offstump, jabbed towards mid-on by Gilchrist, "Yeah" he screams as he hits the ball and the batsmen sprint through for a single
offstump line from Morkel, Suman plays a far more controlled shot, opens the face to guide it to third man for a single
Morkel pitches it up, Suman doesn't bother with any footwork as he swings his bat at it, takes a thick edge and flies over Warne's head at wide first slip
Morkel starts with a wid-ish ball outside off, left alone by Suman
overpitched by Munaf, Gilchrist cracks it towards mid-off, where Carseldine makes a good stop this time
on middle and off, Suman pushes it towards mid-on and takes a single, Carseldine misfields and the batsmen contemplate a second but decide against it
fuller length from Munaf this time, slightly slower ball as well, Suman taps it towards mid-on
on legstump this time, short ball, flicked down to fine leg for a couple
closer to the stumps this time, Suman was early into that an attempted flick, takes the leading edge towards point
Munaf starts with a back of length ball just outside off, slapped towards point by Suman
Slammed over midwicket for six, Morkel strays onto the pads, Gilchrist whips it off his pads and over backward square leg, that's spoils what had been a superb over
and again, accurate stuff from Morkel, another ball in the corridor outside off, Gilchrist defends off the backfoot
good start from Morkel, again in the channel outside off, back of a length, defended back down the pitch by Gilchrist
this time the ball is just outside off, Gilchrist gets on the back foot and  pokes it towards point
bit of a shout for lbw, but that hit Glichrist pretty high on the pads, would have sailed over the stumps
starts off with a delivery down the leg side, that will be a wide
good length, angling into the pads, tucked away towards square leg by Suman

and that's the end of that, another woeful mix-up has Munaf being run out, Munaf poked it towards backward point and set off for a single, though it had gone straight to the fielder, he was sent back but the throw was right over the stumps and Gilchrist takes off the bails with Munaf well short
flighted and on the pads, glanced to short fine leg for a single
very short from Ojha, Jadeja whips it to deep midwicket for a couple
short ball, doesn't rise too high, Jadeja is hit on the pads but the angle was taking the ball down leg
back of a length ball on middle, Munaf was looking to defend, bottom hand came off as he played it to the off side
shortish slower ball, slapped towards point for a single
glanced off his thigh pad towards short fine leg
a yorker outside off ,Munaf squeezes it to the right of the pitch , the batsmen scamper a single
Jadeja shofts his weight to the backfoot, and turns the ball to midwicket for yet another comfortable single
closes the face to work the ball to square leg for yet another single, Jadeja retains the strike
swung to wide long-on for a single by Munaf
full on middle and off, defended back to the bowler
length ball on the pads, nudged to the leg side by Jadeja and they take a single
tossed up outside off, Munaf leans across and swings it on the full to midwicket
lashed powerfully towards point, this time they take the single
back of a length outside off, dropped with soft hands towards backward point
turned to short fine leg, there was a single in it but the batsmen decide Jadeja needs to be on strike and don't take it
backs away and opens the face to guide it to backward point, doesn't bother with running too much, just walks the first few steps before being hurried on by the throw
pushes it fuller this time, Trivedi backs away, and doesn't get anywhere near that delivery, the legstump goes for a walk, only one more wicket needed by Deccan now
throws in the bouncer, 129.0kmh, well-directed, Trivedi evades it by ducking at the last moment
full and on offstump, punched towards extra cover by Trivedi, no run
Trivedi gets onto the front foot and drives that length ball firmly to long-off
worked towards midwicket by Siddharth Trivedi

no need to bother, the golden arm of Rohit strikes again, Warne gave himself a ridiculous amount of room, Rohit didn't bother about that, he kept it on offstump, Warne misses, offstump is on the ground, the ball stayed a bit low
turned towards midwicket to bring new man Shane Warne onto the strike

well, if Rohit Sharma keeps this up he'll soon be in the running for the Purple Cap, this was tossed up by him, well outside off, Morkel gets down on his knee and sweeps hard, a top-edge takes it t square leg where the waiting fielder takes a catch
overpitched outside off, laced powerfully down to long-off by Morkel, a bit of a misfield but no extra run conceded
streaky boundary for Morkel to end the over, RP digs in the bouncer, Morkel pulls, gets a thick top edge which has the ball sailing over the keeper's head for a four
goes for another yorker, but it too much down the legside, he'll have to re-bowl that
played off the backfoot towards backward point, too firmly to have time to take a single
yorker in middle stump, 134.1 kmh, well dug out by Morkel, but that's a dot ball which Rajasthan can ill-afford at this stage
length ball on legstump, Morkel backs away and flicks it towards midwicket, good placement fetches him a couple
low full toss outside off, Jadeja dabs it towards square leg, sprints through for a single
RP starts with a short ball on an offstump line, pulled behind square leg by Morkel
this time he whips it to midwicket, he's very keen on coming back for the second, Jadeja isn't and sends him back, nearly another mix-up there
length ball, play and a miss from new batsman Morne Morkel
Rohit continues to be among the wickets, this was a much quicker ball, full and on legstump, Raut played all over it and the ball crashes into legstump, Rajasthan are into free fall here
swept towards square-leg by Jadeja for a single
swung to midwicket by new batsmen Raut to get off the mark

and there's a wicket off the first ball, terrible running between the wickets,  it was a half-tracker from Rohit, the Asnodkar swiped it to midwicket, Jadeja set off for the second, Asnodkar didn't, then Jadeja stopped, and Asnodkar started to run, Jadeja decides to run as well but Asnodakr was never going to make his ground after that much confusion
fullish from Smith this time, Jadeja hits it hard into the ground, it 's still on the pitch but he's thinks of a single, Gilchrist prevents it by rushing out from behind the stumps
shorter from Smith, swung away towards long-on, couple of bounces before reaching the fielder
Asnodkar was backing away, Smith follows him with a yorker outside leg, batsman misses it and the keeper stops it
played with soft hands towards point, a quick single is taken
slow full toss, on middle and leg, punched down to long-on for a single by Asnodkar
length ball just outside off, square driven towards point for a single
Asnodkar winds up for a big heave over midwicket, but that ball from Ojha spun and bounced lot more than the batsman expected, forcing him to pull out of the stroke
swept to short fine leg for a single by Jadeja

overpitched outside off, Jadeja plays it with soft hands towards midwicket, Jadeja hesitated before taking off for the second, Gilchrist can't collect the throw fired in from Smith, Jadeja could have been in trouble there
cut away from middle stump by Asnodkar, flies down to short third man for a single

Yusuf holes out, the delighted cries from Deccan show how much they value this wicket, it was a shortish ball from Ojha, Yusuf was down the pitch and he flat bats it toward long-off, where Dwayne Smith completes a simple catch
Yusuf gets his front leg out of the way and crunches it to wide long-on for a couple
fuller outside off, Asnodkar make room and creams it behind point for a boundary

terrible fielding from Suman, offspinner from Symonds, sat up after pitching short, Asnodkar swatted it straight to the fielder, who seemed to have it under control, but he can't hang on to it and to make matter worse tips it over for a six
better line, in the channel outside off, pushed towards cover by Asnodkar
persists with the shorter length, on middle and leg, Asnodkar swipes it towards midwicket, the batsmen zip through for a couple
shorter from Symonds, Asnodkar defends to the off side
full on the pads, Yusuf tries to flick it away to the leg side, hit his pad and trickles towards point
driven firmly to mid-off, Symonds can't stop that, gets his hand on it to take the pace off though
close shave for Asnodkar, was hit on the knee roll in front of middle and off, that would have crashed into the stumps, umpire Dharmasena rules it not out though
Yusuf gets a huge stride in, and strokes it firmly past a diving Symonds at short cover
flighted this time, driven to the right of the bowler
went straight on this time, Asnodkar was making room but there was no room and he was cramped, the ball drops on to the pitch off his gloves
an uppish cut from Asnodkar, that was short and wide, took a big top edge, flew wide of the short third man
this time he punches it towards long-on, batsmen take a comfortable single
Asnodkar gives himself some room, and he comes down the pitch and carves it inside-out for a boundary over extra cover
short and wide, Yusuf put everything behind that cut, but the placement is poor, only a single as the fielder in the deep didn't have to move to field that one
a bit of inswing for Symonds, Asnodkar lofts him over mid-on for a single
fired in towards leg, Asnodkar misses the flick and is rapped on the pads
Yusuf goes hard at his first ball, goes towards long-on for a single
gives it a lot of air again, Asnodkar drives it back to the bowler

superb piece of fielding from Ravi Teja,  Naman just chopped the ball towards point and was off for the single, Teja swoops on to it from backward point and throws down the stumps at the non-striker's end, Rajasthan in big trouble here
Naman waltzes down the pitch and slices it inside out over extra cover, not hit too well but there was no fielder in the deep there, the sweeper has to come around a long way to cut it off
punched towards extra cover for a single this time
nicely tossed up, spins away from Asnodkar, who waits on the backfoot and carves it through the covers, the sweeper on the boundary didn't pick the ball at all, so that will be a boundary
Naman comes down the track, and jabs it towards the off side, a quick single is taken
Symonds mixing his length nicely here, this was back of a length, the batsman opens the face and glides it towards short third man
clubs that overpitched ball down to long-on for a single
very short, just outside off, Ojha looks to cut but that was too close to offstump and he misses
fuller this time, and the swing makes good contact, the sails towards long-off, fielder gets it on the bounce
an incutter from Symonds, back of a length, wild swipe from Asnodkar, misses the ball, which narrowly misses offstump
full and outside off, driven to mid-off for a single
gets behind the line and pushes it back to the bowler
opens the face of the bat and steers him down to point
another swish and he mistimes it down the track
tries to slog him again and he mistimes the shot to mid-on
he makes room and swings and gets a lucky inside edge which just beats the stumps and rolls past the keeper
skids through on the middle stump and he makes a bit of room and chops it down to point
short and wide, 115.3 kmh, Ojha goes for a big heave, misses the ball totally
shortish ball angling into Ojha, who back away to make room and plays it towards point
on the pads this time, tickled down fine by Ojha, and it beats a diving Vaas at the boundary
back of a length outside off, chopped towards point by Ojha
short and wide, stays a bit low as Ojha looks to cut it
worked down to third man for a single

Carseldine is out, a bizarre bit of cricket, Carseldine fails to connect with the ball again, it thuds into his back pad, Gilchrist collects this time and belts out an appeal for caught-behind, Carseldine doesn't realise the keeper has the ball and sets off for a single, Gilchrist whips off the bails and asks the square-leg umpire for a stumping, which is upheld

similar length, angling into Carseldine, who misses the ball and is hit on his thigh pad, there's a bit of excitement in the Deccan camp after Gilchrist, who is standing up fails to collect the ball, but there was no bat involved
shortens the length a bit, and more away from the stumps, dabbed towards point
beautiful shot from Carseldine, the ball swung a after pitching on a length around offstump, lovely on-drive beats a diving Venugopal Rao, backfoot was off the ground as he finished the stroke
Vaas' radar deserts him as he tries the slower ball, 109kmh, way down the leg side
starts with a back of a length ball outside off, Carseldine drops it square on of the off side, thinks of a single, before shouting 'No' to send back Asnodkar
tests him with the bouncer, Asnodkar goes for a wild hook, mishit towards midwicket, lands safely though
much better from RP, length ball swinging in after pitching on middle, defended to the off side by Asnodkar
fuller from RP, still gives room for Asnodkar, who slices it between extra cover and mid-off
chases after a short and wide one, the upper cut is one of Asnodkar's favourite strokes, but he didn't make contact with that one
back of a length on middle stump, Carseldine jabs it toward the leg side and gets a single
slightly fuller, same cramping line, punched firmly back down the pitch, another dot ball
RP continues the good work, nice and tight around off, defended back towards the bowler
ooh, another big appeal for lbw, there was an inside-edge though, that was a length ball on legstump, great start from Vaas
angling across the batsman, who leaves it through for the keeper
on middle and leg this time, Carseldine whips it away past midwicket for three
length ball, driven to mid-on by Carseldine, another dot ball
fuller from Vaas, defended back down the track by Carseldine

sensational start for Chaminda Vaas, he gets Smith lbw first ball, Smith had taken a step out of the crease and missed the shortish ball, hit on the pads on a middle-stump line, but that hit him very high on the pad, well above the knee roll
and just like the first over of the Deccan innings, the last ball of the first over goes for four, deftly played by Asnodkar, just opening the face and getting the placement right
very full, on middle stump, Asnodkar inside-edges it onto his boot, great over so far from RP
guides it towards backward point and sets off for a single, is forced to turn back after a diving stop from Rohit
shapes back into the batsman, Asnodkar was looking to cut but was cramped for room, chops it towards point
wide outside off, Smith plays it unconvincingly down to third man, that hit the bottom of his bat before running away
Purple cap owner RP Singh starts off with a back of length ball which seams a bit away from the batsman, who leaves it through to the keeper
